{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# Alpha=4.0 RASP Pipeline: Prune → SFT → GRPO → GSM8K Eval
# Model: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, Sparsity: 20%
# GPU: single GPU (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0)
# Estimated total time: ~3.5-4.5 hours
#
# Usage: bash scripts/run_alpha4_pipeline.sh [gpu_id]
#   gpu_id: GPU index (default: 0)

set -euo pipefail

GPU=${1:-0}

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
cd /root/recovery_aware_struct_prune

MODEL_PATH="/root/autodl-tmp/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B"
IMPORTANCE_PATH="results/importance_scores.pt"
CKA_PATH="results/cka_scores.pt"
BASE_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune"

PRUNED_DIR="${BASE_DIR}/pruned_alpha4_20"
SFT_DIR="${BASE_DIR}/sft_alpha4_20"
GRPO_DIR="${BASE_DIR}/grpo_alpha4_20"
LOG_DIR="${BASE_DIR}/logs"

mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"

echo "========================================"
echo "Alpha=4.0 RASP Full Pipeline"
echo "GPU: ${GPU}"
echo "Start: $(date)"
echo "========================================"

# ============================================
# Step 1: Pruning (α=4.0, sparsity=20%)
# ~5-10 min
# ============================================
echo ""
echo "[Step 1/4] Pruning α=4.0, sparsity=20% ..."
echo "  Output: ${PRUNED_DIR}"

if [ -f "${PRUNED_DIR}/pruning_metadata.pt" ]; then
    echo "  [SKIP] Already pruned."
else
    python src/prune.py \
        --model_path "$MODEL_PATH" \
        --importance_path "$IMPORTANCE_PATH" \
        --cka_path "$CKA_PATH" \
        --mode rasp \
        --sparsity 0.20 \
        --alpha 4.0 \
        --output_path "$PRUNED_DIR" \
        --seed 42 \
        2>&1 | tee "${LOG_DIR}/prune_alpha4_20.log"
    echo "[Step 1 DONE] $(date)"
fi

# ============================================
# Step 2: SFT Warmup (2 epochs)
# ~30-45 min
# ============================================
echo ""
echo "[Step 2/4] SFT warmup (2 epochs, lr=2e-5) ..."
echo "  Input:  ${PRUNED_DIR}"
echo "  Output: ${SFT_DIR}"

if [ -f "${SFT_DIR}/config.json" ]; then
    echo "  [SKIP] SFT already done."
else
    python src/train_sft_warmup.py \
        --model_path "$PRUNED_DIR" \
        --output_dir "$SFT_DIR" \
        --gpu_id "$GPU" \
        --num_epochs 2 \
        --lr 2e-5 \
        --batch_size 1 \
        --gradient_accumulation_steps 8 \
        --seed 42 \
        2>&1 | tee "${LOG_DIR}/sft_alpha4_20.log"
    echo "[Step 2 DONE] $(date)"
fi

# ============================================
# Step 3: GRPO 100 steps (v5 config)
# ~2-3 hours
# ============================================
echo ""
echo "[Step 3/4] GRPO 100 steps (v5 config) ..."
echo "  Input:  ${SFT_DIR}"
echo "  Output: ${GRPO_DIR}"

if [ -d "${GRPO_DIR}/checkpoint-100" ]; then
    echo "  [SKIP] GRPO checkpoint-100 already exists."
else
    python src/train_grpo_v5.py \
        --model_path "$SFT_DIR" \
        --output_dir "$GRPO_DIR" \
        --gpu "$GPU" \
        --max_steps 100 \
        --learning_rate 1e-6 \
        --per_device_train_batch_size 2 \
        --gradient_accumulation_steps 8 \
        --max_completion_length 512 \
        --temperature 0.4 \
        --repetition_penalty 1.15 \
        --num_generations 4 \
        --beta 0.01 \
        --loss_type dapo \
        --format_reward_weight 0.1 \
        --gradient_checkpointing true \
        --optim adamw_8bit \
        --save_steps 100 \
        --save_total_limit 3 \
        --run_name "grpo_alpha4_20" \
        --seed 42 \
        2>&1 | tee "${LOG_DIR}/grpo_alpha4_20.log"
    echo "[Step 3 DONE] $(date)"
fi

# ============================================
# Step 4: GSM8K Evaluation (N=1319)
# ~20-30 min
# ============================================
echo ""
echo "[Step 4/4] GSM8K evaluation (N=1319) ..."
echo "  Model: ${GRPO_DIR}/checkpoint-100"

EVAL_OUTPUT="results/eval_grpo_alpha4_20.json"

if [ -f "${EVAL_OUTPUT}.done" ]; then
    echo "  [SKIP] Eval already done."
else
    python src/eval_gsm8k.py \
        --model_path "${GRPO_DIR}/checkpoint-100" \
        --output_path "$EVAL_OUTPUT" \
        --max_samples 1319 \
        --seed 42 \
        --dtype bfloat16 \
        2>&1 | tee "${LOG_DIR}/eval_grpo_alpha4_20.log"
    echo "[Step 4 DONE] $(date)"
fi

# ============================================
# Summary
# ============================================
echo ""
echo "========================================"
echo "Pipeline Complete: $(date)"
echo "========================================"

if [ -f "$EVAL_OUTPUT" ]; then
    python3 -c "
import json
d = json.load(open('$EVAL_OUTPUT'))
print(f'GSM8K Accuracy: {d[\"accuracy\"]:.4f} ({d[\"n_correct\"]}/{d[\"n_total\"]})')
print(f'EOS rate: {d[\"eos_stats\"][\"eos_rate\"]:.4f}')
"
fi
", "stderr": "", "return_code": 0}, "error": null, "metadata": {"elapsed_seconds": 1.13}}
